name: BusinessAccount
description: The business current account entity. Created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) in BPH-007 upon an approved BusinessApplicationDecisionMade event. The central financial entity in the commercial ledger — analogous to ENT-004 (Account) in the retail domain but owned by CAP-002 and carrying commercial-specific extensions: multi-signatory configuration, payment approval threshold, and business payment rail access. A limited company's BusinessAccount is generally not FSCS-eligible; a sole trader's may be.

fields.name: account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit from the bank's commercial banking sort code range. Validated against Vocalink EISCD modulus checking. Immutable.
fields.transparency_note: Surfaced in full to PER-002 at BPH-007 and business portal.

fields.name: sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit in XX-XX-XX format. Allocated from the commercial banking range (distinct from retail range). Immutable.

fields.name: account_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: business_current | business_current_multicurrency. Immutable without product change journey.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | active | dormant | closed | frozen. 'frozen' blocks all debits and credits for sanctions compliance (GOV-005-R02).

fields.name: opened_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date of BusinessAccountOpened event. Immutable.

fields.name: iban
fields.validation_rule: Required. GB + 2 check digits + 4-letter bank code + 6-digit sort code + 8-digit account number = 22 characters. ISO 13616. Immutable.

fields.name: bic
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 9362 BIC (8 or 11 characters). Immutable.

fields.name: payment_approval_threshold
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp (GBP). Payments above this require dual authorisation.

fields.name: authorised_users
fields.validation_rule: Required. At least 1 user. Each AuthorisedUser: user_id (UUID), name, email, role (enum: sole_authoriser | dual_authoriser | payment_initiator | view_only | admin), added_at, active. Minimum 1 sole_authoriser or 2 dual_authorisers required.

fields.name: daily_payment_limit
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp (GBP). Aggregate daily outbound limit across all payment rails.

fields.name: payment_rails_enabled
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum values: bacs | fps | chaps | sepa. All standard rails enabled by default.

fields.name: fscs_eligible
fields.validation_rule: Required. False for limited companies. True for sole traders meeting FSCS eligible depositor criteria.

relationships.description: BusinessAccount belongs to one BusinessCustomer via business_customer_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: authorised_users stored as an array on BusinessAccount — not a separate entity.
design_decisions.rationale: Authorised user configuration is account-level data tightly coupled to the account lifecycle. User identity credentials are owned by SVC-100 (IAM); authorised_users on BusinessAccount stores only the account-level role assignment.

design_decisions.decision: BusinessAccount uses a distinct sort code range from personal accounts (ENT-004 Account).
design_decisions.rationale: Distinct ranges allow immediate identification of payment traffic as business vs retail. Non-overlapping allocation from Pay.UK EISCD ensures no confusion in downstream payment processing.
